description: Reads the user's Forkmate notifications, newest first: notices that something the user reported was fixed, Forkmate release notes (what's new), and account messages. Each one has a kind, a title, a body, an optional link, the day it arrived and whether it is unread, and the reply includes the unread count. Read-only: reading marks nothing as read. Notifications older than 180 days are not kept.

limit.description: How many to return, newest first (1 to 20, default 10).

unread_only.description: Only unread notifications. Defaults to false.

name: get_notifications
